content.title: Sanmina (SANM) Earnings Beat: Margin Gains Reinforce Bullish Growth Narratives
content.summary: Sanmina (SANM) reported robust numbers, with earnings projected to rise 30.8% per year and revenue expected to grow 31.3% per year, both outpacing US market averages. Net profit margin improved slightly to 3% from 2.9% last year, which helped drive annual earnings growth of 10.5%, notably above the five-year average of 4.8%. These metrics hint at an acceleration in growth and operating performance, even as the stock trades above the industry's average valuation based on discounted cash flow...

content.title: SANM Q3 Deep Dive: Cloud and AI Acquisition Drives Revenue Upside, Eyes on Integration
content.summary: Electronics manufacturing services company Sanmina (NASDAQ:SANM) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3.9% year on year to $2.10 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($3.05 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 43.3% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.67 per share was 6.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
